question: Which country is involved in Ulchi Freedom Shield is an annual joint military exercise?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**US-South Korea**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• US-South Korea Hold Ulchi Freedom Shield Military Drills.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Ulchi Freedom Shield** is an **annual** joint military exercise between South Korea and the United States.

 
 
• 
 
It is designed to **reinforce readiness** and cooperation across all domains to defend the **Korean Peninsula** and the broader region.

 
 
• 
 
The drills trace back to the **1960s**, starting as the **Taeguk Exercise**.

 
 
• 
 
The exercise has evolved over the years, including iterations like **Ulchi-Focus Lens**.

 
 
• 
 
In **2008**, the name was changed to **Ulchi-Freedom Guardian**.

 
 
• 
 
This year’s drills focus on **upgraded responses** to heightened **North Korean nuclear threats** and **cutting-edge technologies** used in modern warfare.
